judgment.notes: n is the total integer expression λ+1. Positivity is not granted by this definition: H001 and N001 supply it where used.
I is the integer interval 0≤i≤λ, with i locally bound. It is finite even when empty; H001/N001 supply nonemptiness and cardinality n. All family indices and finite-sum conventions are explicit.

X(r)=x^r/r! is defined only for nonnegative integer r over ℂ, with identity at r=0. Factorials there are nonzero. Its representation action is distinguished from its later lattice and characteristic-p realizations; preservation and invertibility are exported in N002/N004.
Y(r)=y^r/r! has the same nonnegative integer domain and characteristic-zero denominator guard as X. Later lattice preservation and reductions are proved claims, not part of this definition.
U_Z is precisely the unital integer subalgebra generated by all X(r),Y(r). This matches problem.md; lattice stability remains the explicit condition H004.
e:I→V is defined by y^i v/i!, with I ensuring i≥0. No basis or nonzero property is assumed here: N001 is the explicit producer of those properties.

R consists of rational fractions with nonzero denominator not divisible by p, with the specified embedding into ℂ. H001 is its explicit guard and is direct in R002–R005; R002/S001 supplies subring closure and denominator units. The definition assumes no PID or rank-one result.

M_R is the scalar-extension R-module R⊗_ℤ M; M is already an additive subgroup and hence a ℤ-module. No image embedding or freeness is granted here. Its R dependency and pure-tensor convention are explicit.

ι_M is the linear extension of balanced multiplication (r,m)↦rm. Additivity and integer balancing give a well-defined map. Image identification is explicitly deferred until injectivity; N002 exports injectivity and is direct in its later consumers.

E_ij is the coordinate operator relative to e. Guard N001 supplies the actual complex basis, ensuring existence and uniqueness by finite coordinate expansion. Every inference using E (R002–R004) directly includes N001; the definition does not assume lattice preservation.
Π is Y(λ)X(λ) with composition order fixed. H001 guards λ≥0 in the divided-power domains and is direct wherever Π is used. Equality with E_λλ is exported by N002, not silently assumed.

J_i is the inverse image of the R-submodule ι_M(M_R) under c↦c e_i. Zero, addition and R-scalar closure follow directly from those linear maps. Nonzeroness, finite generation, equality and rank one are not granted by the definition; they are N003 claims.

J=J_0 is well-defined since H001 gives 0∈I. Its submodule structure is inherited from D012; equality of all coefficient modules, nonzeroness and cyclicity are separately exported in N003. H001 is direct in R003/R004.
V_K=M⊗_ℤ K with the K-action on the second factor is exactly the original reduction for the arbitrary M. Nonzeroness and a basis are not assumed; N004 exports them.

L_K is the scalar extension of the specified integer Chevalley span with its inherited bracket. N002 is the construction guard for bracket closure, direct in R004/R005. This preserves the characteristic-2 Chevalley construction rather than assuming distinct reduced weights.

ρ_K is the explicitly specified induced action on pure tensors, with invariance notation fixed. N002 exports lattice preservation, balanced well-definedness and the Lie action and is a direct input in both consumers. The definition introduces no extra stability assumption.

F_p is ℤ/pℤ with quotient operations and the canonical integer-residue map into K. H001 explicitly supplies primality and characteristic p; R004 is its only inference consumer and directly lists H001. This introduces neither algebraic closure of K nor a choice of a different residue map.
